visual_prompt: Start on an impossible glowing rectangular doorway floating in a real-looking illustrated blue sky; smash zoom to Stickman staring upward. Strong immediate movement, mystery; doorway is an anticipatory flash-forward; next scene rewinds.
movement: Fast push-in on glowing doorway; wind lifts grass and clouds shift behind it
character: The same approved Stickman in red hoodie and white round face, close-up shock
QA_guard: HOOK: first image must be visually impossible, not a quiet walk

visual_prompt: Rewind with a quick hand-drawn swoosh to a bright grassy hill. Reveal one small cyan-blue chalk key glowing in short grass, Stickman picks it up.
movement: Gentle dolly-in; grass waves; two drifting cloud layers; key pulses
character: Stickman same head/hoodie/sneakers; key stays cyan-blue in every shot
QA_guard: Keep key design identical all following scenes

visual_prompt: Stickman holds glowing chalk key and draws a luminous blue rectangle in air, line follows moving tip stroke-by-stroke; sky bends like paper.
movement: 2D vector stroke reveal; parallax hills; tiny glow sparks, no image wobble
character: Full-body animation with proper hand-to-key contact
QA_guard: Use a real sequence of strokes, not an abrupt appearance

visual_prompt: Door handle clicks, outline gains depth, the magical illustrated door opens on a hinge to reveal sky light; wind brushes Stickman hoodie.
movement: Door rotation on hinge + bloom; foreground leaves blow; snap reaction
character: Stickman remains same size relative to door, expressive surprise
QA_guard: Prevent portal clipping and inconsistent door edges

visual_prompt: Inside is a wide spectacular, rich 2D cloud kingdom of floating rock islands with golden bridges, teal shadows, rotating miniature windmills, glowing birds and distant pink skies.
movement: Epic slow parallax zoom across 4 depth layers; rotating blades; real bird fly cycles
character: Stickman stands at threshold as small foreground silhouette
QA_guard: Match scenic reference line work, no photographic elements

visual_prompt: Stickman carefully steps into cloud realm; the door closes behind him and vanishes, leaving a few fading hand-drawn sparkles.
movement: Feet planted with weight transfer; portal dissolves in hand-drawn line segments
character: Backpack, hoodie and sneakers persist; silhouette readable
QA_guard: No teleport jump; show door closing with physics

visual_prompt: Stickman pauses. From behind a floating cliff comes a tiny dragon cry. Animate his expression, turn of the head and small footsteps toward sound.
movement: Dramatic wind dip, camera pan toward distant cliff; clouds continue moving
character: Stickman eyebrows and eye direction point to cliff
QA_guard: Sound motivation must be clear

visual_prompt: Cute tiny red dragon with warm yellow belly and small wings trapped by translucent lavender crystal vines at the rim of a floating island. Storm glows below.
movement: Dragon blinks, wings flutter, vines pulse; swirling clouds below
character: Follow supplied red dragon reference: do not turn it teal or blue
QA_guard: Show dragon not harmed; crystal vines physically entangle wing and foot

visual_prompt: Stickman races along existing narrow golden bridge toward dragon, hovering clouds underneath; a few boards wobble as he runs.
movement: Contact-aware 2D run cycle, bridge shake and particles, side tracking camera
character: Same Stickman proportions, arms not rubbery
QA_guard: Never use random body jitter as animation

visual_prompt: Storm crystal discharges blue sparks; Stickman draws a cyan shield with chalk key that grows line by line and catches the sparks.
movement: Animated shield stroke, impact flashes, bright spark trails, controlled camera
character: Hand holds key correctly, shield remains stable after creation
QA_guard: Shield should block sparks, not look pasted over a frame

visual_prompt: The dragon is above reach. Stickman sketches a solid ladder, climbs two rungs and draws giant silver scissors in air.
movement: Stroke reveal -> ladder solidifies; simple deliberate climb; windmill spins in distance
character: Keep consistent object scale and visual causal steps
QA_guard: Scissors safe stylized tool, no violent impact

visual_prompt: Scissors cut crystal vines in two decisive cycles; dragon tumbles, Stickman catches it in an embrace. Big readable emotional beat.
movement: Crystal shards dissolve as sparkles; dragon bounces once; short celebratory push-in
character: Red baby dragon body, yellow belly, wing anatomy remain consistent
QA_guard: Show the physical catch, do not teleport the dragon

visual_prompt: Close-up of cracked storm crystal glowing electric blue and purple. A ring of turbulence spreads through floating islands; bridge bends.
movement: Lens-free stylized glow, growing crack strokes, cloud whirlwinds, light flicker
character: Stickman and dragon react at foreground edge
QA_guard: Maintain clean outlines in motion; do not shake every layer

visual_prompt: Golden bridge behind them breaks apart plank by plank and falls into clouds; Stickman shields dragon and steps away.
movement: Controlled sequential bridge-break animation, falling particles, tracking pull-back
character: No injuries, no gore, dragon safely held
QA_guard: Match bridge shape from scene 9

visual_prompt: Key energy dims to one blue sparkle; Stickman imagines a rocket, then a sword in pencil-outline thought bubbles, rejecting them.
movement: Dim key glow, thought-bubble icons float and dissolve, deep breath animation
character: Keep face readable; rocket and sword remain unreal silhouettes
QA_guard: Emotion and choice must read without subtitles

visual_prompt: Stickman chooses kindness: raises key and draws an enormous warm golden heart shape around the storm crystal; line finishes with a bright snap.
movement: Large flowing curved vector stroke synchronized with gesture, glow bloom
character: Character shown in same red hoodie foreground
QA_guard: Heart stays clearly a drawn 2D shape, not a 3D prop

visual_prompt: Heart wraps around unstable crystal. Crack seals piece by piece, storm lightning retracts; windmills stop spinning wildly and return to normal.
movement: Animated cracks reverse, particle ring dissolves, camera eases back
character: Dragon watches from Stickman shoulder
QA_guard: Show clear cause and effect, not an instant unrelated cut

visual_prompt: Sun breaks through clouds; baby red dragon sneezes shimmering bubbles in soft rainbow light. One bubble grows around Stickman and dragon.
movement: Cloud layers part, sunray wipe, dragon head recoil, bubble expanding physically
character: Dragon red with yellow belly; Stickman outfit unchanged
QA_guard: Echo EP01 bubble magic without recycling the old scene

visual_prompt: Bubble carries both toward a faraway majestic golden cloud castle surrounded by small floating islands; doors slowly swing open.
movement: Smooth upward arc, 4-layer parallax clouds, distant castle grows with consistent perspective
character: Both comfortably visible in translucent bubble
QA_guard: Show castle as destination, not a static wallpaper

visual_prompt: Inside the open castle doorway, two enormous glowing golden eyes blink. Close on Stickman and dragon reacting; end with WHAT WOULD YOU DRAW NEXT? plus discrete SUBSCRIBE FOR MORE card.
movement: Slow camera advance; deliberate blink, 0.5s stunned reaction; clean final 2.7s end slate
character: Use approved brand identity; do not insert a dog or extra character
QA_guard: End slate must NOT cover last question or run beyond 100.000s
